# OmniLogo

The continuous-line “omni” wordmark (20u stroke, 10° lean); use in the rail head, splash, docs.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.OmniLogo`

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.OmniLogo />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.OmniLogo"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Omni wordmark — always just "omni", no "OS". "omni" as one continuous 20u line leaning 10°; the o is the mark's ring. variant: wordmark ("omni") · mark (fluid mark only). `live` puts the fluid OmniMark beside the word (use on splash/about, not in chrome).
